remarks: Charming Cape Cod in the Fabulous Mid-Ridges Neighborhood! This classic 4-bedroom, 3-bath Cape Cod offers an incredible opportunity to personalize and update, with plenty of potential to make it your own. Hardwood floors underneath carpeting on first floor. Nestled in the desirable Mid-Ridges area, this home features a spacious layout with generous storage and a partially finished lower level.  The expansive deck off the kitchen is perfect for outdoor living, making it ideal for entertaining or simply enjoying the fresh air. In addition, the detached 2-car garage with a loft provides ample space for hobbies, storage, or a future workshop. Hook up for generator on side of the house.  Located in a sought-after neighborhood, this home is a fantastic opportunity for those looking to create their dream space. Don't miss out-schedule a showing today and explore the possibilities!
